name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
target_group: Eligible BPL widows aged 40–79 years under NSAP rules
eligibility: Widow must satisfy the current NSAP eligibility criteria.
benefits: Central pension assistance of ₹300/month for eligible widows aged 40–79 and ₹500/month for 80+, plus applicable state contribution.
application_process: Apply through the state/UT social-welfare mechanism designated for NSAP.
source: Ministry of Rural Development / Government of India
